blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Lawyer Theodore Te is among the lawyers assisting the House prosecution panel in the impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte. Te is the interim chairperson of the Free Legal Assistance Group (Flag), described as the oldest network of human rights lawyers in the Philippines, and a full time faculty member of the University of the Philippines, where he holds the rank of assistant professor. READ: https://newsinfo.inquirer.net/2257487/sara-duterte-impeachment-trial-everything-you-need-to-know He previously served as chief public information officer and spokesperson of the Supreme Court.
